notes:
{関|かん}する is a formal verb meaning "to concern" or "to relate to." It primarily appears in the patterns below.

KEY PATTERNS:
- 〜に{関|かん}する + Noun: regarding ~, concerning ~ (modifies noun)
- 〜に{関|かん}して: concerning ~, with regard to ~ (adverbial)
- 〜に{関|かん}しては: as for matters concerning ~

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- 〜について: about, regarding (neutral, most common)
- 〜に{関|かん}して: concerning (formal, written style)
- 〜に{関連|かんれん}して: in connection with (emphasizes connection)

REGISTER:
This is a formal expression common in written Japanese, news, academic writing, and official documents. In casual speech, 〜について is more natural.

EXAMPLE CONTEXTS:
- {法律|ほうりつ}に{関|かん}する{問題|もんだい}: legal issues
- {健康|けんこう}に{関|かん}する{情報|じょうほう}: health information
